issues.advice: Add an alt text saying what the image shows, or an empty one (alt="") for a decoration
issues.message: The image carries no alt attribute: a recipient who cannot see it is told nothing of it.

markup.advice: Remove dangerous HTML tags like <script>, <iframe>, <object>, <embed>, <applet>, <form>, and <base> from email content
markup.message: Dangerous <script> tag detected - JavaScript is blocked by most email clients

rendering.advice: Darken the text or lighten what is behind it until the pair reaches 4.5:1
rendering.message: Text in #ff0000 on #f0f0f0 measures 3.51:1, below the 4.5:1 WCAG AA asks of it (2 places).

rendering.advice: Add <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"> to the head; without it a mobile client renders at desktop width and scales the result down
rendering.message: The HTML declares no viewport, so a phone renders it at desktop width and scales the result down.

text_alternative.advice: Generate the text part from the HTML at send time rather than maintaining it by hand; two parts this far apart usually mean the text of a previous campaign was left in place while the HTML was rewritten
text_alternative.message: The plain text and HTML parts do not say the same thing.
